finding: 26% of Chicagoans live within a half-mile walk of an ‘L’ station; 22% live that close to an accessible one. About 115,000 live near the ‘L’, but only near non-accessible stations.

ledger.source: CTA - System Information - List of 'L' Stops
method: Half-mile walk (805 m) on the OpenStreetMap walk network, extract of 2026-11-01
Step-free: the same network without stairs and ways tagged wheelchair=no; elevators and ramps kept
Blocks placed by the walk from their internal point to the nearest station
Stations: Day 01 rule, accessible only if every platform is flagged accessible
caveats: OSM does not record every missing curb ramp or broken sidewalk; the step-free walk is an upper bound
ADA flag lags CTA: Austin (Green), reopened accessible Aug 2026, is still flagged non-accessible
Ambulatory difficulty: ACS 2020-2024 tract estimates spread over blocks by population

source.name: CTA - System Information - List of 'L' Stops
